latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Product Culture Assessment skill.

- Enables structured assessment of a team's or company's product culture across 14 attributes (7 innovation, 7 execution).
- Categorizes organizations into one of four quadrants: Dreamers, Factories, Elite, or Stalled.
- Generates a prioritized 90-day improvement roadmap based on the assessment.
- Designed for leaders, founders, and product managers to identify cultural gaps and inform change.
- Provides guidance on when to use this skill versus related diagnostics.
- Works from qualitative observations—no codebase access required.
